what: Addendum AD manifest: every remote file the reading downloads (URL, size, digest), LiveBench's scorer states and versions, the vendored files, and the frame counts made at scoping. Written before the freeze; pinned by the protocol.
held_out_rule: Before the freeze nobody downloads or reads an answer file, a judgment file, or a published table value. Every digest of a table here was computed by the scoping agent or published by the host as a git blob id; this file was built from code, category maps, git tree and commit metadata, and Hugging Face API metadata only.
